_doc: Data-driven reach-for table consumed by .claude/hooks/next-step-hint.js. Adding a new tool = appending one entry. Each row: signal (heuristic name), command (slash-command or skill to invoke), after_step (1=discuss, 2=plan, 3=execute, 4=qa, 5=ship; null=any). The hook picks rows whose after_step matches the just-completed step. Synced from github.com/shiniguchi/toolkit — edit there, not downstream.

rows.note: new UI surface — review an existing page first for patterns to reuse
phase touches auth, secrets, OWASP-relevant code, or SQL with user input
DB schema change — get a second pair of eyes
branch ready to open as a PR
bug appeared mid-build, root cause unclear
doc-only / comment edit / variable rename — replaces full sequence
live web data — search, scrape, structured extraction, competitive analysis, SEO audit
validate, optimize and document what changed this session

rows.command: use gws CLI (.claude/vendor/gws + sheets.json), not browser tools
rows.note: Sheets grid is canvas-rendered; browser automation falls back to screenshots (most expensive path). Build payload.json locally, one gws call.
